categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of high-performance quartz glass materials and products, quartz glass fibers, and composite materials based on quartz glass fibers. Its main business segments include quartz glass materials and products, quartz glass fiber materials, composite materials, and precision processing of quartz glass mask substrates. The company serves key industries such as semiconductors, aerospace, optics, photovoltaics, and optical communications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including gas-melted quartz glass, synthetic quartz glass, electric-melted quartz glass, and quartz glass fiber production. It has developed proprietary technologies for low-expansion synthetic quartz glass, high-uniformity synthetic quartz, low hydroxyl and chlorine-free synthetic quartz, and electronic-grade quartz fibers. Production methods include batch processing, precision machining, 2.5D and 3D weaving of quartz glass fiber fabrics, and composite material manufacturing with automated production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the semiconductor manufacturing sector, aerospace industry, precision optics, photovoltaic industry, and optical communications. The company supplies major semiconductor equipment manufacturers such as Tokyo Electron, Lam Research, Applied Materials, and domestic semiconductor equipment firms. It also serves aerospace manufacturers, optical system developers, photovoltaic producers, and optical fiber manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for about 68% of revenue, and has growing overseas markets representing about 32% of revenue. It has subsidiaries and production bases in multiple Chinese provinces including Hubei, Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu, and Shandong. Export activities involve customers in international semiconductor and optical industries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Feilihua operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing quartz glass raw materials, intermediate products, and finished quartz glass components. It also extends upstream by producing high-purity synthetic quartz sand and downstream by providing precision quartz glass processing and composite material manufacturing, offering integrated solutions along the quartz glass industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven development with significant R&D investment focused on key materials technology breakthroughs, including low-expansion quartz glass, high-purity synthetic quartz sand, and advanced quartz glass fibers. It aims to enhance domestic substitution in semiconductors and aerospace, expand composite materials applications, and improve digital and talent management capabilities. Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity, deepening industry chain integration, and maintaining technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of quartz glass materials, quartz glass products, quartz glass fibers, and composite materials. The company operates a direct sales model, fulfilling customer orders with customized production. It also earns income from technology development, licensing, and technical services related to new materials and equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier and one of the few global manufacturers with mass production capability of quartz glass fibers. It holds a dominant position in China's aerospace quartz fiber market and is a key supplier to major semiconductor equipment manufacturers. Competitors include other domestic and international quartz glass producers, but Feilihua emphasizes its comprehensive product range and integrated industry chain as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.74 billion, a decrease of 16.68% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 314 million, down 41.56%. Total assets reached about RMB 6.09 billion, with net assets of RMB 4.13 billion. Despite short-term market fluctuations, the company maintains steady cash flow and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a focus on long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hubei Feilihua emphasizes providing high-performance, high-purity quartz glass materials and products with superior thermal stability, chemical resistance, and optical properties tailored for critical high-tech industries. Its integrated product portfolio from raw materials to composite structures offers customers one-stop solutions, ensuring quality control and cost efficiency. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and certifications from leading semiconductor equipment manufacturers differentiate it as a trusted partner in strategic sectors like semiconductors and aerospace.
